scope: Primary-source research only. No cart mutation, order, vendor contact or supplier CAD substitution.

selected_machine.spindle: Owned 65 mm ZhongHuaJiang 1.5 kW ER11 kit
selected_machine.magazine_slide: Owner-reported 311 mm overall, 200 mm travel SFU1605 motion module
selected_machine.existing_magazine_capacity: Four-pocket RapidChange ER11, exact vendor geometry not supplied
selected_machine.existing_endpoint_lock: Current revision uses passive captured horizontal tongues/roofs; former removable shoulder bolts/nuts/washers removed.

options.form_observation: ER11 Type A is offered. Four pockets is the minimum on the current direct form. The Basic model excludes IR tool detection and dust cover; Pro adds $100 and Premium adds $200 on this direct form.
options.recommendation: Retain current four-pocket selection until a delivered alternative with complete selected-variant geometry is established.

options.function: Modular automatic load/unload with tool/nut state confirmation; manufacturer says it requires a reverse-capable spindle, one controller input, and a tool setter for full measurement automation.
options.price_conflict: The expansion standalone page showed a $150 sale while the control product addon showed $175. A cached shop wizard also showed a $175 control sale while the current direct control form showed $200. No cart price or delivered total was verified; do not combine cached sale prices into a claimed quote.
options.requirement_change: Reduces magazine capacity from four tools to two and changes supplier mounting geometry. Not adopted.
options.recommendation: Only a candidate if two pockets are acceptable; a $25 conservative goods saving does not resolve the whole-machine budget.

options.reason_rejected: Manufacturer explicitly describes a manual/semi-automatic single-pocket product requiring the operator to place the next endmill. It cannot be substituted silently for unattended multi-tool ATC.

options.source_spindle: Standard ER20 2.2 kW at approximately 700 rpm
options.reason_rejected_for_direct_substitution: Primary README describes ER20. BOM, assembly and configuration sections contain TBC placeholders. No documented ER11 variant or ER11 clamp-torque qualification was found. Uniform scaling does not establish ER11 nut compatibility, engagement, spindle inertia or reliable tightening.

queries: site.aliexpress.com ER11 automatic tool changer magazine
ER11 tool changer retrofit magazine automatic low cost manufacturer
options.result: No primary selected-variant listing with both documented ER11 retrofit function and usable mounting/engagement geometry was verified. Conventional ATC spindle or ISO/HSK tool forks are different interfaces and were not counted as a cheap compatible magazine. This is a research result, not proof that no such product exists.

automatic_slide_lock_engineering.reason: The present shoulder bolt plus nut/washer supplies both location and uplift retention. Merely retracting a plain vertical pin loses the uplift clamp function.
automatic_slide_lock_engineering.candidate_architecture: Pneumatic guided-pin alternative researched but not selected; no cylinder/valve cost or geometry is included in the actual new passive revision.
automatic_slide_lock_engineering.note: A family from-price is not a quantity-extended selected-cylinder budget. Cylinder stroke, magnet/confirmation version, mounting, ports, pressure, pin bearing/shear, hose clearance and all solids require a complete redesign/check before adoption.
automatic_slide_lock_engineering.implemented_architecture: Integral billet tongues/bearing lands, welded fixed guide cheeks/capture roofs and opposite endpoint stops. Existing owned SFU1605 axis drives directly in/out; no separate lock actuator or manual endpoint bolts.

conclusion.no_silent_downgrade: No Solo/manual changer, ER20 open-source mechanism, bare ISO tool fork or generic unpriced cylinder was substituted for the requested ER11 automatic tool changer.
